snippet.title: 007 First Light – Official Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
The return of James Bond to gaming in 007 First Light has been nothing short of amazing and we are honoured to be on this journey with you.

GET NOW

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/007Gameioi

Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/007Gameioi 
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/007FirstLight/

Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

ABOUT IO INTERACTIVE 
IO Interactive is an independent videogame developer and publisher with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, Istanbul, and Brighton. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last two decades, IOI is dedicated to creating unforgettable characters and experiences using their award-winning proprietary Glacier technology. IO Interactive has developed and published a reimagined James Bond origin story with 007 First Light and is currently developing a new IP under the codename Project Fantasy. For more information, visit: https://ioi.dk.
